blocks.tamil_translation: times, and likewise” washed his left foot three times. After that he said, “I saw the Prophet ﷺ make Wudu just as I have made Wudu.” After finishing the Wudu, Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever makes Wudu as I have made Wudu and prays two rak'ahs without bringing any other thought into the Salah, all his previous sins are forgiven.” Hazrat Ibn Shihab (RH) narrates, “Our scholars say that making Wudu in this way is the complete Wudu for Salah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ أَرْبَعاً - شَكَّ سَهْلٌ - يُحْسِنُ فِيهِمَا الرُّكُوعَ وَالْخُشُوعَ، ثُمَّ اسْتَغْفَرَ اللهَ غُفِرَ لَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٥٦٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “If a person makes Wudu well and prays two or four rak'ahs (the narrator of this hadith is unsure whether it was two rak'ahs or four rak'ahs), making ruku' well in them and praying with devotion, and then asks Allah for forgiveness of his sins, he is granted forgiveness.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرِ نِ الْجُهَنِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَيُحْسِنُ الْوُضُوءَ وَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ يُقْبِلُ بِقَلْبِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا إِلَّا وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever makes Wudu well and prays two rak'ahs, fully engaging his heart in the Salah and keeping his limbs at rest, Jannah surely becomes due for him.” The Prophet ﷺ
